sum: Wholegrain bread, rice and pasta.
f: Swap one food at a time

sum: Poses, breathing and relaxation.
w: Take care with glaucoma (inverted poses) and osteoporosis.

sum: An intensity at which you can still talk.
Popular for weight loss and blood sugar.
b: Small reduction in blood sugar after meals
w: Erodes tooth enamel. Low potassium in large amounts.

sum: An antioxidant used in some countries for diabetic neuropathy.
w: May lower blood sugar: take care if you use diabetes medicines.

sum: A form of carnitine that reaches the brain.
w: May cause restlessness or insomnia. Take care with hypothyroidism.

sum: Supplements sold for the headache after drinking.
w: Paracetamol with alcohol puts strain on the liver.

sum: A plant source of DHA and EPA, like fish.
b: DHA for vegans and in pregnancy
w: Generally safe.

sum: The gel is used on the skin, the juice by mouth.
w: The latex (aloin) is a strong laxative and possibly carcinogenic. Low blood sugar with diabetes medicines.

sum: Sources of choline that reach the brain.
b: Memory in older adults with mild impairment
Large ICTUS trial found no benefit
w: Headache, insomnia.

sum: A flavonoid found in chamomile.
w: Little safety data.

sum: A precursor of nitric oxide.
w: Avoid after a heart attack (VINTAGE MI trial) and with herpes. Interacts with nitrates and Viagra.

sum: Artichoke leaf extract.
w: Avoid with gallstones.

sum: An Ayurvedic "adaptogen" herb.
w: Rare reports of liver toxicity. Avoid in pregnancy, hyperthyroidism and autoimmune disease.
s: Root extract reduced perceived stress and cortisol.
Chandrasekhar 2012 prospective randomized double-blind placebo-controlled study of safety and efficacy of ashwagandha root extract stress
Salve 2019 adaptogenic and anxiolytic effects of ashwagandha root extract

sum: A red pigment from microalgae. Gives salmon its colour.
w: Generally safe. May slightly colour the stools.

sum: A herb from traditional Chinese medicine.
w: Take care with autoimmune disease and immunosuppressants.

sum: Needed for carbohydrate metabolism and nerve function. Risk of deficiency with alcohol, diuretics and after bariatric surgery.
w: Very safe at usual doses.
s: High-dose thiamine reduced fatigue in patients with IBD.
Costantini 2013 thiamine and fatigue in inflammatory bowel diseases pilot study

sum: Needed for the nervous system and making red blood cells. Risk of deficiency in vegans, older adults and people on metformin or antacids.
u: Numbness in hands and feet goes away
fd: A vegan diet usually also needs a supplement
w: Generally safe. B12 and homocysteine tests help diagnose deficiency.
s: 1000–2000 µg by mouth as effective as injections for deficiency.
Butler 2006 oral vitamin B12 versus intramuscular vitamin B12 for vitamin B12 deficiency

sum: Key for energy production in the mitochondria.
b: Migraine prevention at high dose (400 mg)
f: Often combined with magnesium and CoQ10
w: Very safe.
s: Schoenen 1998 effectiveness of high-dose riboflavin in migraine prophylaxis

sum: A precursor of NAD+. Niacin and nicotinamide have different effects.
b: Nicotinamide: fewer non-melanoma skin cancers in high-risk people
u: Skin flushing and burning with niacin
Better skin texture with topical niacinamide
f: Flush, liver toxicity at high doses
w: High doses of niacin need monitoring of the liver and blood sugar.
s: Nicotinamide 500 mg twice a day reduced new skin cancers by 23% (ONTRAC).
Chen 2015 phase 3 randomized trial of nicotinamide for skin cancer chemoprevention
Niacin on top of a statin did not reduce cardiovascular events.
AIM-HIGH 2011 niacin in patients with low HDL cholesterol levels receiving intensive statin therapy
No benefit and more side effects.
HPS2-THRIVE 2014 effects of extended-release niacin with laropiprant

sum: A coenzyme in fat and hormone metabolism. Deficiency is very rare.
w: Very safe. High doses may cause diarrhoea.

sum: Involved in amino acid metabolism and making neurotransmitters.
u: Vivid dreams when taken in the evening
Numbness at high doses over months
w: Long-term intake above 50–100 mg/day may cause peripheral neuropathy.
s: Vutyavanich 1995 pyridoxine for nausea and vomiting of pregnancy
Possible benefit in PMS up to 100 mg/day, low quality.
Wyatt 1999 efficacy of vitamin B-6 in the treatment of premenstrual syndrome

sum: Needed for DNA synthesis and cell division. Critical before and during pregnancy.
b: Preventing neural tube defects in the baby
Mainly in populations without food fortification
f: The form used in pregnancy studies
Active form, useful with MTHFR variants
w: High doses can mask B12 deficiency. Often combined with B12.
s: Folic acid prevented about 72% of repeat neural tube defects.
MRC vitamin study 1991 prevention of neural tube defects
Enalapril with folic acid reduced first strokes by 21% (CSPPT).
Huo 2015 efficacy of folic acid therapy in primary prevention of stroke CSPPT
Wang 2007 efficacy of folic acid supplementation in stroke prevention meta-analysis

sum: An Ayurvedic herb for memory.
w: Nausea, diarrhoea. Take care with thyroid medicines.

sum: Leucine, isoleucine, valine. Already present in every complete protein.
b: Muscle growth when protein is adequate
w: Rarely needed if dietary protein is adequate.

sum: All the B vitamins together.
b: Covering deficiencies in alcoholism, poor diet
w: High B6 long-term: neuropathy. Urine turns bright yellow.

sum: Pollen collected by bees.
w: Anaphylaxis in people allergic to pollen. Interacts with warfarin.

sum: A fat-soluble form of thiamine with better absorption.
w: Generally safe.

sum: An alkaloid from plants such as barberry. Affects sugar and lipid metabolism.
b: Lower glucose and HbA1c in type 2 diabetes
w: Many interactions (drug metabolism in the liver). Constipation. Not in pregnancy or breastfeeding.

sum: Extract from a citrus fruit from Calabria.
w: Little safety data.

sum: Raises carnosine in the muscles, which delays fatigue.
b: Performance in hard efforts of 1–4 minutes
w: Harmless tingling of the skin (paraesthesia).

sum: A soluble fibre from oats, barley or fungi.
w: Gas at first.

sum: Sold for "low stomach acid".
w: Avoid with gastritis, ulcers and anti-inflammatory painkillers.

sum: A coenzyme in metabolism. Widely sold for hair and nails.
b: Hair and nails when there is a real deficiency
Hair in healthy people without deficiency
f: Very high doses (5–10 mg) have no proven benefit
w: High doses distort blood tests (troponin, thyroid). Stop 2–3 days before a blood test.
s: Benefit only in people with an underlying deficiency or condition.
Patel 2017 a review of the use of biotin for hair loss

sum: A herb for menopausal hot flushes.
w: Rarely serious liver damage. Stop if jaundice or dark urine appear.

sum: A trace element that affects bone and hormone metabolism.
w: Upper limit 20 mg/day.

sum: Resin from the frankincense tree with anti-inflammatory action.
w: Stomach and gut upset.

sum: An enzyme from pineapple.
w: Raises bleeding risk with anticoagulants. Pineapple allergy.

sum: A basic building block of bone. Food sources are preferred.
b: Small reduction in fractures with vitamin D in older adults
w: Diet first. Separate from iron and thyroid medicines.
s: Calcium (with or without D) reduced fractures by 12%.
Tang 2007 use of calcium or calcium in combination with vitamin D supplementation to prevent fractures
About 30% higher risk of heart attack with calcium supplements.
Bolland 2010 effect of calcium supplements on risk of myocardial infarction

sum: A stimulant of the nervous system.
w: Take care with arrhythmias, anxiety, pregnancy (up to 200 mg). Pre-workouts often contain very high doses.

sum: A form of calcium absorbed even without stomach acid.
w: Separate from iron and thyroxine.

sum: Carries fatty acids into the mitochondria. The body makes it on its own.
w: Fishy odour. At high doses raises TMAO (uncertain significance for the heart).

sum: A non-psychoactive component of cannabis.
w: Interacts with many medicines (liver enzymes). Liver toxicity at high doses. Legal status varies by country.

sum: One of the most popular drinks for relaxation.
w: Allergy in people sensitive to ragweed. Take care with warfarin.

sum: Binds substances in the gut.
w: Also binds medicines (contraceptives etc.): keep at least 2 hours apart. Constipation.

sum: A green microalga.
b: Small reduction in blood pressure and lipids
w: Contains vitamin K: take care with warfarin.

sum: Needed for the liver, cell membranes and the neurotransmitter acetylcholine. Important in pregnancy.
w: High doses cause a fishy body odour and low blood pressure.

sum: A component of cartilage, often combined with glucosamine.
w: Take care with anticoagulants.

sum: A trace element studied for blood sugar control.
b: Small reduction in fasting glucose in type 2 diabetes
w: Rarely kidney or liver damage at high doses. Take care with insulin.

sum: A spice studied for blood sugar.
b: Small reduction in fasting blood sugar
w: Cassia cinnamon contains coumarin, toxic to the liver in large amounts.
